Casting your Class Ability grants 'Hellion' for 20 seconds. 

Hellion fires <solar/>Scorching projectiles every 1.35 seconds up to a distance of 32 meters, and inflict 30 <solar/>Scorch per hit in a 4 meter radius (40 Scorch with <solar/>Ember of Ashes).

Hellion projectiles count as a Grenade Ability and are buffed by, and trigger, grenade-specific effects. However, <solar/>Scorch and <solar/>Ignitions sourced by Hellion itself do not scale.

Enhances your <solar/>Healing, Firebolt, Solar, and Fusion Grenade Abilities:

• <solar/>Healing Grenades grant <solar/>Cure x2 and <solar/>Restoration x2 for 4 seconds (6 with <solar/>Ember of Solace)
• <solar/>Firebolt Grenades gain 50% increased search radius (8🠚12 Meters) and targets 5 enemies (up from 4).
• <solar/>Solar Grenades last 2 seconds longer and release 'Molten Lava Orbs' that deal additional damage.
• <solar/>Fusion Grenades detonate a second time after 0.5 seconds, dealing additional damage in an 8 meter radius.

Passively grants 20 Airborne Effectiveness. Allows you to use your weapons and abilities while gliding. 

Kills while Airborne grant Melee Energy based on <link Combatant Rank [#CombatantClassifications] />:
• Minors: 20% //T1
• Elites: 25% //T2
• Minibosses: 35% //T3
• Bosses and Players: 50% //T4

//#ChunkEnergyScalars

Hold [Grenade] to consume it, activating 'Heat Rises' for 15 seconds, and grant <solar/>Healing to you and allies within a 9 meter radius based on what was consumed. 

Consuming a <solar/>Healing Grenade grants <solar/>Cure x3. If <solar/>Touch of Flame is equipped, this also grants <solar/>Restoration x1 for 4 seconds. 

Consuming a <solar/>Song of Flame Wisp grants <solar/>Cure x3 and <solar/>Restoration x2 for 4 seconds. 

Restoration effects are extended to 6 seconds with <solar/>Ember of Solace. All other grenades grant <solar/>Cure x2. 

Heat Rises grants 50 Airborne Effectiveness and effectively infinite Glide flight time, along with improved base movement capabilities of your equipped Glide. Enemy combatants are less accurate while Heat Rises is active.

Scoring kills while Airborne extends Heat Rises, up to a maximum of 30 seconds based off <link Combatant Rank [#CombatantClassifications] />:
• Minors and Players: 5 seconds //T1
• Elites and Minibosses: 10 seconds //T2+T3
• Bosses: 15 Seconds //T4

While Airborne, pressing [Air Move] performs a horizonal dash that propels you 8 meters towards the input direction before entering a 4 second cooldown.

While <solar/>Heat Rises or <solar/>Song of Flame is active, gain an additional charge of Icarus Dash before entering a 5 second cooldown (currently only works in <solar/>Song of Flame while using <solar/>Incinerator Snap). Both charges are refilled per cooldown period.

Icarus Dash can be used infinitely during <solar/>Daybreak at the cost of 4.2% super energy per use.

While Airborne, Weapon or Super Kills within 5 seconds of each grants <solar/>Cure x1. Activation Progress is based on <link Combatant Rank [#CombatantClassifications] />:
• Minor: 34%
• Elite: 67%
• Bosses: 100%
• Players: 67%

Holding [Heavy Attack] throws your blade 20 meters forward in a straight unguided path and increases its damage by 100%.

Holding [Reload] <title refills [G_refill] /> the magazine based on the number of stacks and converts them into 'Revolution' stacks. Switching modes again removes all stacks.

Revolution stacks remain ready until fired, after which point they last 10 seconds. Arc Seekers gain <pve 30% /> <pvp [Varying] /> increased damage per stack of Revolution, up to 450% increased damage. 

Arc Seekers also gain a non-linear increase to their splash radius, granting 33%|233% increased splash radius at x10|x20 Stacks (up to 4|7 meters in radius).

While Revolution's timer is active, Arc Seekers generate x2 <arc/>Bolt Charge for each hit and gain the ability to discharge <arc/>Bolt Charge stacks. At or above 10 stacks of Revolution, hits generate x3 <arc/>Bolt Charge.

<arc/>Bolt Charge generation is unaffected by <arc/>Spark of Frequency.

Review this exotic's intrinsic perk to learn a special note about the <arc/>Bolt Charge behavior from this gun.

Firing this weapon consumes one stack of Soulfire Charge to apply Potent Corruption (poison) that increases in DOT over time.

In total, one application of Potent Corruption deals <pve 2,985 /> <pvp [?] /> damage.
